headline_stat.name: fraction of place cells with significant negative precession slope

justification.dataset: Dandiset 000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1, sub-Achilles) is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta phase precession.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile; NaN gaps in the linearized channel were correctly diagnosed and position rebuilt from raw 2D tracking with direction-split running epochs and excitatory-only unit selection.
justification.analysis: Circular-linear regression with a position-shuffled null distribution is the standard, correct method with the required control for circular data.
justification.correctness: The 54/65 (83%) significant-negative count and median -0.66 cyc/field reproduce from the committed code and are internally consistent with fig07.
justification.figures: Effect is clearly visible, examples are selected by fit strength (smallest p / highest R), and panels carry units and sample sizes.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate with no overstatement or cherry-picking, but the write-up states no explicit limitation, capping a genuinely clean result at 3.
